hints.tr: `"abc/".rstrip("/")` sağdaki çizgiyi, `"/abc".lstrip("/")` soldaki çizgiyi siler. Çizgi yoksa metne dokunmazlar.
hints.en: `"abc/".rstrip("/")` removes the slash on the right, `"/abc".lstrip("/")` the one on the left. If there is no slash they leave the text alone.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
def endpoint_url(base, path):
    return base.rstrip("/") + "/" + path.lstrip("/")


print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1", "weather"))
print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1/", "/weather"))
print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1/", "weather"))
print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1", "/books/42"))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
def endpoint_url(base, path):
    return base.rstrip("/") + "/" + path.lstrip("/")


print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1", "weather"))
print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1/", "/weather"))
print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1/", "weather"))
print(endpoint_url("https://api.example.com/v1", "/books/42"))
```
